definitions.gloss: wreath; garland; a circular arrangement of flowers or greenery
definitions.explanation: A ring-shaped decoration woven from flowers, leaves, or artificial flowers. In Japan, large standing {花輪|はなわ} on stands are commonly sent to shop openings, theatrical performances, and funerals as formal congratulatory or condolence gifts. The word also covers smaller hand-made flower crowns and wreaths for doors or graves.

examples.japanese: {開店祝|かいてんいわ}いに{花輪|はなわ}を{贈|おく}った。
examples.english: I sent a floral wreath to congratulate them on the shop's opening.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちはシロツメクサで{花輪|はなわ}を{作|つく}って{頭|あたま}にのせた。
examples.english: The children made wreaths out of white clover and put them on their heads.

examples.japanese: {劇場|げきじょう}の{入口|いりぐち}には{初日|しょにち}を{祝|いわ}う{花輪|はなわ}がずらりと{並|なら}び、{出演者|しゅつえんしゃ}の{名前|なまえ}がそれぞれに{書|か}かれていた。
examples.english: At the theater entrance, wreaths celebrating the opening night were lined up in a row, each bearing the name of one of the cast members.

notes:
Compound of {花|はな} ('flower') and {輪|わ} ('ring; circle'). In this word {輪} undergoes rendaku: わ → わ (no voicing, because わ is already a plain kana — no change), so the reading stays はなわ rather than はなば. The word can also be read かりん in some older or specialist contexts, but はなわ is standard.

USAGE:
- In contemporary Japan, the most culturally distinctive use is the large standing {花輪|はなわ} — a tall circular floral display on a stand, bearing a ribbon with the sender's name — sent to:
  - Shop, restaurant, or office openings ({開店|かいてん}・{開業|かいぎょう}{祝|いわ}い)
  - Theater, concert, or stage performance openings ({公演|こうえん}・{初日|しょにち}{祝|いわ}い)
  - Funerals and memorials ({葬儀|そうぎ}・{告別式|こくべつしき})
- Small woven {花輪|はなわ} are associated with children playing with clover, daisies, or other small flowers.
- For Christmas wreaths hung on doors, the loanword リース is far more common than {花輪|はなわ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花輪|はなわ}を{贈|おく}る: to send/give a wreath
- {花輪|はなわ}を{飾|かざ}る: to display a wreath
- {花輪|はなわ}を{作|つく}る: to make a wreath
- {開店|かいてん}{祝|いわ}いの{花輪|はなわ}: an opening-celebration wreath
- {葬儀|そうぎ}の{花輪|はなわ}: a funeral wreath

SIMILAR WORDS:
- リース: wreath (Western style, especially Christmas) — loanword used for door wreaths and seasonal decorations.
- {花冠|はなかんむり}・{花冠|かかん}: flower crown — worn on the head, rather than displayed or hung.
- {花束|はなたば}: bouquet — flowers bundled, not arranged in a ring; given as a gift.
- {供花|きょうか}・くげ: funeral flowers offered to the deceased — broader category that includes wreaths and other floral arrangements at funerals.
